notes: A Welsh deposit return scheme would cut drinks container litter reaching beaches and rivers, a land and water pollution pressure under SI4. The source is a campaign group arguing a case, and the government response is the next thing to look for.
summary: Surfers Against Sewage published a guide urging responses to the Welsh Government consultation 'Delivering a Best for Wales Deposit Return Scheme', which closed on 20 November 2025. It called for an all-in scheme including glass, legally binding reuse targets separate from recycling targets, and a wider national plan to end plastic pollution, citing Million Mile Clean data of 121,674 volunteers collecting over 54 tonnes of rubbish from January to September 2025. The consultation outcome and the scheme design were not settled on the page.
title: Welsh Government consults on a 'Best for Wales' Deposit Return Scheme; Surfers Against Sewage presses for glass and reuse targets
